_doc: Small-indicator battery table. Single source of truth for regex tells (small strings that instantly signal a vuln class). Add a row when you learn one (engagement close-out, research ingest); keep patterns HIGH-PRECISION (a noisy tell trains the eye to ignore the battery). class/skill route the hit; note says what to read next.
